remarks: Experience elevated downtown Stamford living in this beautifully renovated 6th-floor corner residence, showcasing captivating views of the city and Mill River Park. From beautiful sunrises to vibrant city lights, this exceptional one-bedroom apartment offers 788 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, abundant natural light, and an inviting atmosphere. Nearly every detail has been updated, including flooring, cabinetry, countertops, appliances, fixtures, doors, trim, and custom closet storage. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, air conditioning, and garage parking. Unwind on the building's rooftop terrace while taking in beautiful sunset views. Ideally situated near Mill River Park, downtown restaurants, shopping, UConn Stamford, and Stamford Hospital, this residence offers the perfect balance of city living and comfort. Available furnished or unfurnished. One parking space included in the monthly rent. Available for immediate occupancy. Schedule your private showing today!
